items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Pete Bailey was on tenor. Luther West, alto, Pete Bailey on tenor and Roy Walker trumpet and me on trombone.

ctx.x: He had a brother, Joe Walker, and Joe played with Louie also.
There was somebody else in there besides--oh yeah, Pete Bailey was on tenor. Luther West, alto, Pete Bailey on tenor and Roy Walker trumpet and me on trombone.
What was the nickname you called Luther West?
